tasks.label: docker build admin_webapi runtime amd64
tasks.command: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 -t rust-engine-admin-webapi-runtime:latest -f presentation/admin_webapi/Dockerfile --target runtime .

tasks.label: docker export admin_webapi linux amd64
